usage: sot-validator curate [-h] [--curation-db CURATION_DB] [--snapshot SNAPSHOT]
                            [--output OUTPUT] [--export-json EXPORT_JSON]
                            [--import-json IMPORT_JSON] [--site-id SITE_ID] [--actor ACTOR]
                            [--reason REASON] [--target-type TARGET_TYPE] [--target-id TARGET_ID]
                            [--name NAME] [--hostname HOSTNAME] [--category CATEGORY]
                            [--role ROLE] [--vendor VENDOR] [--model MODEL] [--vlan-id VLAN_ID]
                            [--subnet-id SUBNET_ID] [--room ROOM] [--notes NOTES]
                            [--pin-classification PIN_CLASSIFICATION] [--delete]
                            [--add-device [ADD_DEVICE]] [--template-id TEMPLATE_ID]
                            [--device-id DEVICE_ID] [--management-ip MANAGEMENT_IP]
                            [--port-count PORT_COUNT] [--add-port ADD_PORT]
                            [--port-range PORT_RANGE] [--poe-status POE_STATUS]
                            [--admin-status ADMIN_STATUS] [--oper-status OPER_STATUS]
                            [--connected-device-id CONNECTED_DEVICE_ID]
                            [--connected-mac CONNECTED_MAC] [--add-vlan ADD_VLAN] [--cidr CIDR]
                            [--gateway GATEWAY] [--list-audit] [--limit LIMIT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --curation-db, --db-path CURATION_DB
                        Path to SQLite CurationStore database or JSON state file (default:
                        ./curation.db).
  --snapshot, --snapshot-file SNAPSHOT
                        Optional Site JSON snapshot file to apply curation overlay against.
  --output, --output-snapshot OUTPUT
                        Optional output path for the curated Site JSON snapshot (or audit log
                        JSON).
  --export-json EXPORT_JSON
                        Optional path to export the full CurationStore state as JSON.
  --import-json IMPORT_JSON
                        Optional path to import CurationStore state from JSON before applying
                        operations.
  --site-id SITE_ID     Optional site ID context for patches, custom devices, and audit log
                        filtering.
  --actor ACTOR         Operator identifier recorded in the audit log (default: cli-operator).
  --reason REASON       Audit reason for the curation change.
  --target-type TARGET_TYPE
                        Target entity type to patch or delete (NetworkDevice, Port, VLAN, Subnet,
                        IPAddress, Equipment).
  --target-id TARGET_ID
                        Target entity identifier to patch or delete.
  --name NAME           Updated name for patched item, custom device, or VLAN.
  --hostname HOSTNAME   Updated hostname for patched item or custom device.
  --category CATEGORY   Updated EquipmentCategory (server, vm, ups, san, other).
  --role ROLE           Updated device or host role (e.g. router, switch, l3_switch, hypervisor,
                        ups, nas).
  --vendor VENDOR       Updated hardware/software vendor name.
  --model MODEL         Updated hardware/software model name.
  --vlan-id VLAN_ID     VLAN ID to assign to patched item, custom device, or port(s).
  --subnet-id SUBNET_ID
                        Subnet ID to assign to patched item or custom VLAN.
  --room ROOM           Room/rack location to assign to patched item.
  --notes NOTES         Operator notes to attach to patched item.
  --pin-classification, --pinned-classification PIN_CLASSIFICATION
                        Pin ValidationClassification on the target item (e.g. 'Confirmed Active').
  --delete              Mark the specified (--target-type, --target-id) item as deleted.
  --add-device [ADD_DEVICE]
                        Add a custom NetworkDevice (optionally passing hostname or device_id).
  --template-id, --template TEMPLATE_ID
                        DeviceTypeCatalog template ID (e.g. extreme-exos-48p, unifi-multi-vlan-
                        router).
  --device-id DEVICE_ID
                        Device ID for --add-device or port curation (--add-port / --port-range).
  --management-ip MANAGEMENT_IP
                        Management IPv4 address for --add-device.
  --port-count PORT_COUNT
                        Override port count when instantiating a device.
  --add-port ADD_PORT   Add or update a single port by name on --device-id (e.g. '1:1' or 'eth1').
  --port-range PORT_RANGE
                        Add or update a range of ports on --device-id (e.g. '1:1-1:24' or
                        'eth1..eth8').
  --poe-status POE_STATUS
                        PoE status for added/updated port(s) (e.g. delivering, auto, off).
  --admin-status ADMIN_STATUS
                        Administrative status for added/updated port(s) (default: up).
  --oper-status OPER_STATUS
                        Operational status for added/updated port(s).
  --connected-device-id CONNECTED_DEVICE_ID
                        Connected downstream device or equipment ID for added/updated port(s).
  --connected-mac CONNECTED_MAC
                        Connected MAC address for added/updated port(s).
  --add-vlan ADD_VLAN   Add or update a custom VLAN with the specified VLAN ID.
  --cidr CIDR           Subnet CIDR when adding a custom VLAN with --add-vlan.
  --gateway GATEWAY     Gateway IP when adding a custom VLAN with --add-vlan.
  --list-audit          Print the CurationStore audit log as JSON to stdout.
  --limit LIMIT         Maximum audit log entries to return with --list-audit (default: 100).
